hook: Dull (鈍) feeling (感): someone who does not notice things, thick-skinned.
Forget (忘れ) for one time (度): a sudden moment when a word slips your mind.
A shop (屋) you ask (問) for goods in bulk: a wholesale store.
The inner (内) palace hall (閣): the group of top ministers, the cabinet.
Then (乃) ... reaching (至): from A up to B, or simply 'or'.
Stored (蔵, storehouse) inside (内): built-in, like a camera built into a phone.
Disorder (乱) inside (内) a country: civil war.
Land (陸) on the inside (内), far from the sea: inland.
Long (長) and long again (々): very long, drawn out.
The middle (中) extent (程): halfway, midway.
渚 has the water radical 氵: the place where the water meets the beach.
嘆 means sigh: you sigh and moan, to lament and grieve.
Throw (投げ) out (出す): throw something out, or give up on it.
The person (人) in the middle of the relationship (仲) of two families: the matchmaker.
和 means peace and harmony: a calm, friendly mood.
Without (無い) heart or sympathy (情): pathetic, miserable, shameful.
Deep (深い) in feeling (情): kind and caring, warm-hearted.
詰 means press or pack: you press someone hard with words, to scold.
A name (名) held high (高い): famous.
Snow (雪) collapses (崩): an avalanche.
懐 means bosom or heart: a pet that comes to your chest, becomes attached to you.
Attach (付ける) a name (名): to name.
Name (名) + tag or card (札): a name tag.
Smelling (臭い) of raw (生) fish or meat: fishy, bloody smell.
Raw (生), not fully warm (温い): lukewarm, and also half-hearted.
Live (生) body (身): flesh and blood, a real living person.
滑 means slide or slippery: so smooth that things slide over it.
嘗 has 旨 (tasty) at the bottom: you lick to taste; also to look down on.
悩 means worry: something that troubles your heart, or tempts you.
To cause worry (悩): to bother or trouble someone.
並 means line up side by side: A lined up with B, a formal 'and'.
Become (成り) standing (立つ): something stands up, is made of parts, or works logically.
馴 means tame, used to: acting too used to someone, overly familiar.
What (何) is it? Somehow, I do not know why.
Similar (似) things going back and forth (通う): to closely resemble.
賑 has 貝 (shell, money): lots of money and people, busy and lively.
憎 means hate: the feeling of hatred.
Flesh (肉) and parent or relative (親): your blood relatives.
Flesh (肉) body (体): the physical body.
Flee (逃げ) out (出す): to run away, escape.
The west (西) sun (日): the afternoon sun shining in from the west.
滲 has 氵 (water): ink or water spreading and blurring.
にせ (fake) thing (物): a counterfeit, an imitation.
担 means carry on the shoulder: to bear a burden or responsibility.
鈍 means dull, blunt: to become dull or weaker, like a blunt knife.
Even (にも) without being affected (関わらず): in spite of that, nevertheless.
Comes into (入) your hand (手): to obtain.
Enter (入) the prizes (賞): win a prize or place.
Enter (入) the bath (浴): bathing.
尸 (body) + 水 (water): water from the body, urine.
Recognise (認) and know (識): awareness, recognition.
Both kanji have 女 (woman): a woman carrying a baby, pregnancy.
Entrusted (任) duty (務): your mission or task.
Entrust (任) by order (命): to appoint someone to a post.
抜 means pull out: you pull something out, leave it out, skip it.
Slip out (抜け) and leave (出す): to sneak away, or stand out from the rest.
沼 has 氵 (water): water that stays still, a swamp or pond.
The colour (色) of a sound (音): tone, timbre.
Make someone lie down (寝): put to bed, or leave dough to rest.
捩 has 扌 (hand): twisting with your hand, to get twisted.
妬 means jealousy (女 + 石, a heart like stone): to envy someone.
Hot (熱) will or mind (意): enthusiasm, zeal.
Hot (熱) water (湯): boiling water.
Amount (量) of heat (熱): calories.
粘 means sticky (with 米, rice, which is sticky): stickiness, or not giving up.
Sticky (粘) like rice: to stick, or to keep going without giving up.
Going around (回し) the roots (根) before moving a tree: quietly preparing people before a decision.
眠 means sleep: wanting to sleep, sleepy.
練 means practise, refine: knead dough, or polish a plan.
A wish (願) held in your thoughts (念): your heart's desire.
Year (年) name or number (号): the era name, like Reiwa.
Burn (燃) and burn (焼): combustion.
Longer (長) in years (年): older, senior.
Year (年) rings (輪): the rings inside a tree trunk.
Farming (農) and ploughing (耕): agriculture.
Farm (農) place (場): a farm.
Farm (農) land (地): agricultural land.
Deliver (納) into (入): to pay or supply goods.
逃 means escape: to let something escape, to miss a chance.
逃 means escape: to escape, get away from something.
Eaves (軒) in a row (並): a row of houses; all of them, one after another.
望 means hope: something hoped for, desirable.
Get on (乗っ) and take (取る): to hijack or take over.
罵 has 馬 (horse) under a net (罒): shouting rough words, to abuse.
延 means extend: stretched out, or the total added together.
Drink (飲み) in deep (込む): to swallow, and also to understand.
Get on (乗り) into (込む): board a vehicle, or march in.
Grip (把) and grasp (握): firmly understand.
Abolish (廃) and throw away (棄): disposal.
菌 means germ: bad germs, bacteria.
A person (者) paired with you (配偶, partner): your husband or wife.
Bow (拝) and open (啓): 'Dear sir', to begin a formal letter.
The scene (景) behind your back (背): the background.
Humbly bow (拝) and borrow (借): may I borrow this?
Push out (排) and remove (除): exclusion.
Compensate (賠) and repay (償): paying for damage you caused.
Push out (排) water (水): drainage.
Lose (敗) a war (戦): defeat in war.
Distribute (配) and place (置): arrangement, layout.
Distribute (配) into parts (分): allotment.
Lose (敗) and turn your back (北, its old meaning): defeat.
The rate (率) of times (倍): magnification, or how many applicants per place.
Distribute (配) into a line (列): arrangement, array.
Break (破) and destroy (壊): destruction.
One (一) general (概) rule for every case: usually in 一概に言えない, you cannot generalise.
著 means stand out, as in 著名 (famous): very noticeable, remarkable.
All as one (一) and the same (同): everyone present.
One (一) part (部分): a portion.
One (一) parting (別): since we last parted.
One (一) face or side (面): one side; or the whole surface.
One (一) eye (目) look: a glance.
One (一) way or style (様): all the same, uniform.
One (一) linked chain (連): a series.
Tie (括) into one (一): all at once, in a batch.
In one (一) move (挙): at a single stroke.
One (一) change (変): changes completely all at once.
営 means run or manage: to run a business, or hold a ceremony.
挑 means challenge (with 扌, hand): to take on a challenge.
Rice-plant (稲) light (光): lightning, once believed to help rice grow.
祈 means pray (示 is the altar radical): a prayer.
未 means not yet: still, not yet.
Moving (移) people (民): immigrants, emigrants.
Hate (嫌) it, hate it (々): doing it unwillingly.
卑 means low, humble: low-class, greedy, vulgar.
Will (意) and desire (欲): motivation.
Might (威) and power (力): great power.
Clothing (衣) kinds (類): clothes.
Different (異) argument (論): objection.
Seal (印) + 鑑 (model, mirror): your official name stamp.
Shadow (陰) mood (気): gloomy.
Hidden (隠) living (居): retired from work and staying quietly at home.
Receive (受け) and continue (継ぐ): to inherit.
Receive (受け) and attach (付ける): to accept applications, like at reception.
Receive (受) and hold (持ち): something in your charge, like a class.
One who tells (つき) lies (嘘): a liar.
An unplanned sleep (寝): dozing off for a short nap.
Hit (打ち, for force) open (明ける): to open up and confess.
Strike (打ち) out (消し): denial, the negative form.
Hit (打ち) into (込む): drive in, or throw yourself into work.
A round (団) fan (扇): the flat round fan used in summer.
The inner (内) explanation (訳): a breakdown of items.
Empty (空): hollow, blank.
What your arm (腕) can do in front (前) of you: skill.
Rain (雨) weather or sky (天): rainy weather.
促 means urge: to push someone to act.
Attached (つき) since birth (生まれ): by nature.
Bury (埋め) into (込む): to embed.
Turn over (返し) to the back side (裏): inside out.
Selling (売り) out to the public (出し): a sale.
Put out (出す) to sell (売り): to put on the market.
潤 has 氵 (water): becoming moist, and money flowing in too.
Floating (浮) heart (気): a wandering heart, cheating on a partner.
植 means plant: to be planted.
Carry (運) and manage (営): running an organisation.
Carry (運) and send (送): shipping goods.
Carrying (運) fee (賃): fare, freight charge.
云 means say: say this, say that, and so on.
Carry (運) and transport (搬): hauling things.
Luck (運) and life (命): fate.
Carry (運) and transport (輸): transportation.
Move (運) and use (用): putting to practical use, managing funds.
English (英) letters (字): the alphabet.
Project (映) a copied image (写): showing a film on a screen.
Brilliant (英) and brave (雄, male): a hero.
Inspect (閲) and look (覧): browsing, reading documents.
Things (物) you catch (獲): game, prey, spoils.
襟 has 衤 (clothing): the part of clothes around the neck, the collar.
Round (円) and slippery (滑): smooth, without trouble.
Along (沿) the shore (岸): coast.
Graceful (婉) and bent (曲): saying it indirectly, not straight.
Perform (演) and bring out (出): direction or production of a show.
演 means perform: to act a role.
Older form of 演じる: 演 means perform, to play a role.
Along (沿) the line (線): areas along a railway line.
Talk (談) of a bond (縁): a marriage proposal.
Far (遠) direction (方): a distant place.
Round (円) and full (満): peaceful and harmonious.
Chase (追い) into (込む): to drive into a corner.
Chase (追い) out (出す): to kick out.
於 means at or in: において marks where or when something happens.
老 means old: to grow old.
Respond (応) to something urgent (急): emergency, first aid.
Yellow (黄) metal (金): gold.
Go (往) and examine (診): a doctor's house call.
The big (大) side (方): most, the majority.
Big (大) pattern or build (柄): large-bodied, or a big design.
The big (大) line (筋): the outline.
Big (大) sky (空): the wide sky.
Big (大) water (水): a flood.
犯 means crime: to commit a crime or break a rule.
侵 means invade: to invade someone's land or rights.
Timid (臆) sickness (病): cowardice.
遅 means late: to make late, delay.
厳 means strict, solemn: dignified and solemn.
収 means collect, put away: to fit into place, settle.
納 means store, deliver: to be put away properly, settled.
治 means govern, cure: to calm down, be at peace.
産 means give birth: childbirth.
Push (押し) and cut (切る) through: get your own way despite objections.
惜 means regret, value: to regret losing, or use something carefully.
